limitations: Retained rawResponse objects are parsed provider JSON; original wire bytes and duplicate provider-envelope keys are unavailable.
Dispatch authorizations are counted conservatively. No provider billing statement or direct hidden execution trace was inspected.
Requested/effective settings and token usage are retained/reported evidence, not proof of hidden reasoning correctness or physical model execution.
Reasoning tokens are a subset of output tokens and are not added again. No monetary cost is inferred.
Empty budget-truncated responses establish no visible answer; no hidden mathematical label or failure mechanism is inferred.
The five prior studies, failed standard reserve,120 prior unknown remote outcomes and their incomplete populations remain preserved; none is replaced or pooled into this diagnostic.
The600-second method does not change the standard180-second platform/profile deadline, generated functions, reference labels or memberships.
Adaptive selection,18 tasks and two related source groups preclude ranks, confidence intervals and a stronger signal. No claim of universal absence of frontier errors is supported.
